name: SMC Integration Solutions, LLC
old_description: SMC offers a complete solution for your EMS and Systems Integration needs. We have separate focused engineering groups for Customer Engineering, Test Engineering, Process Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Systems Integration, as well as a very strong Strategic Business Management role. SMC provides technical resources for New Product Introduction (NPI), through all levels of volume production.
about:
SMC Integration Solutions, LLC was founded in 1996 in Nicholasville, Kentucky. The privately held company operates two facilities in the heart of Kentucky, serving the technology industry in the eastern region.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services (EMS) and systems integration, including printed circuit board assembly, custom cable and wire harness assembly, complex box build, and full assembly testing. Its capabilities span new product introduction (NPI) and rapid prototyping through low-, medium-, and high-volume production. SMC maintains five dedicated engineering groups—customer, test, process, quality, and systems integration—supported by a strategic business management function. The operations team comprises engineers and professionals with 30-plus years of experience assembling high-technology products.

SMC serves the medical device, aerospace and defense, industrial controls, security, military/DOD, construction, and transportation industries. Medical customers include manufacturers of MRI, PET, and CT imaging equipment as well as biomedical freezers. The company is ISO 13485:2016 registered for medical devices, ISO 9001:2015 registered, FDA registered, and manufactures to IPC-A-610 Rev G standards. A recent blog post notes a contract manufacturing agreement with COMSovereign for radio production.

SMC emphasizes a partnership model built on its “4 P’s”—Principles, People, Process, and Performance—and offers direct fulfillment to end customers. Differentiators cited by the company include an electronic 8D corrective-action system integrated with its ERP, a manufacturing execution system tailored for EMS, and in-house development of test systems to ensure product reliability.
